title: Mother and Child with Vintage Car, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage 1940s black and white candid snapshot capturing a mother and her young toddler posing outdoors near an automobile. The woman wears a cardigan, scarf, high-waisted trousers, and a classic 1940s victory roll hairstyle, while the child sits atop the car hood. Handwritten annotations on the front margin read 'Sunday Morning' and 'Desert near...'.
